get.summary: Resolve an exact CI request to its native Run
get.description: Requires current service run:read permission and independently retained service binding. Unknown, unbound, invisible, revoked and unavailable mapping all return the same NOT_FOUND 404; a provider outage returns 503. A resource-independent operation denial may return 403 before lookup. No-store applies to every response. See docs/service-identity.md.

200.description: Authorized current observation. All responses MUST use Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: requestIssuer
parameters.description: Exact immutable Integration request identity; never dereference or treat as authorization.

parameters.description: Exact immutable Integration request identity; never dereference or treat as authorization.
